title: From Sunwell to Dawnwell
summary: The Void invasion of Quel'Thalas, the Sunwell's transformation into the Darkwell, and the elven coalition's response form an ongoing modern arc.
opening: The Sunwell had been restored before, but its latest defense drew old divisions and new allies toward a crisis that changed the well again.

chapters.title: The invasion of Quel'Thalas
chapters.body: Begin with the released Void incursion and the defense of Quel'Thalas, keeping the coalition's factions distinct rather than painting one inferred territory.

chapters.title: The Darkwell
chapters.body: Xal'atath turns the Sunwell into the Darkwell. The timeline records Alleria and Turalyon's disappearance there; their ultimate fates should not be inferred from that moment.

chapters.title: An uneasy coalition
chapters.body: Trace the elven alliance and its response using the released timeline, then verify each participant's actions from the corresponding quests.

chapters.title: The Dawnwell
chapters.body: The Dawnwell's restoration closes one released chapter. Later Worldsoul Saga outcomes remain open and should be appended only after their sources are available.

reviewNote: The broad sequence is released history; exact quest chronology, character fates, and later saga outcomes still need review. Keep this arc distinct from Arator's relic search.
